name: G2 journey bar and Problems panel
description: Report §10 slices S2 and S3 on an isolated fixture with one unconnected resistor (fixture-command, SETUP). The journey bar above the documents shows ERC not done while no ERC report exists for the revision (never done). The bottom dock's Problems tab names ERC, DRC and DFM as not run (unknown, not absent) and lists the release gate's blockers before any check. After a board outline and a via on the signal net SIG, which has no declared voltage (fixture-commands, SETUP), Run ERC in the Problems tab lists the resistor's ERC findings and turns the journey's ERC stage to has-errors; a click on the finding goes through the F7 navigation (the resistor is selected on its sheet) and the Problems tab stays shown. Run DRC lists DRC-002 as UNKNOWN with the missing input named (no declared voltage for: SIG). The source chip hides and shows the release blockers, the text filter keeps only rows that mention SIG, and the UNKNOWN row opens Design rules, where net voltages are declared. Journey stages open their views: Layout opens the PCB editor and Release opens the read-only release check. The Findings tab itself is unchanged (b5-findings.json, f7-navigation.json).
